technologies: Member AG Energies AG Energies is a leading renewable energy company dedicated to providing sustainable solar solutions across East Africa. We specialise in the distribution of high-quality solar components such as photovoltaic panels, solar water heaters, pumps, and street lights. Through partnerships with top manufacturers, we ensure the delivery of reliable, cost-effective, and durable products to meet the growing energy demands of residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Additionally, we offer customised solar systems tailored to specific client needs, helping businesses reduce electricity bills and carbon footprints. At AG Energies, we also provide extensive training and support to local installers and resellers, empowering them with the skills to install and maintain solar systems. With a commitment to innovation, we are dedicated to promoting clean energy solutions while advancing Africa’s energy transition for a brighter and more sustainable future. Our services are backed by exceptional customer support and industry-leading warranties.
